purpose: Reconcile existing guest expiry, revocation and temporary-access evidence without performing new actions.

requirement.scope: Expired/revoked access denial across page, feedback, media and PDF endpoints.

actual_expiry_evidence.environment: Actual local app against canonical services; normal Producer and account-free incognito guest. Hosting was deferred.
actual_expiry_evidence.carry_forward_scope: Prior actual expired-parent original-media denial may carry as dated M06 evidence. It is not a mock result.
limits: Earlier fill-only saves did not change expiry and were not credited.
No 30-day natural wait or current Gp3 hosted expiry observation is claimed.
This receipt does not prove an expired-only hosted page, feedback or PDF endpoint matrix.

actual_hosted_revocation_evidence.limits: Later passage of the deadline cannot turn this already-revoked link's denial into an isolated expiry proof. These two HTTP reads are not all AT-051 endpoints.

guest_lifecycle_and_export.scope: Owned isolated local24 synthetic SQL; expiry, extension, rotation, revocation and export-access assertions. DDL/data rolled back; no hosted configuration, provider or real media.

composed_Storage_RLS.scope: Owned isolated local26 synthetic Storage metadata; real anon/authenticated SQL roles and composed SELECT expiry/revocation denials. All candidate DDL/data rolled back.

remaining_scope.unverified_live_scope: The retained receipts do not establish an expired-only hosted original-token/session/page, feedback and PDF endpoint matrix. Broader synthetic assertions remain separate. This is an existing AT-051 evidence limit, not a new gate or required replay of the earlier actual expiry check.

temporary_access_cleanup.limits: Cleanup is supported at the recorded observations, not by a fresh current inventory. Original OAuth sessions and unrelated review links were intentionally preserved; they are not cleanup targets. An unconfirmed refresh-denial phase is not evidence of active temporary access.
